finding.cause: TempestBellPlayer primary set includes base_deal_no_damage; equipped alternate-set Razor Quarterstaff is selected. The oracle calculates damage for the same primary label without respecting that stat. Primary set has no damage multiplier; Slam/Shockwave are separate damage sets. No weapon or skill-selection change justified.
finding.culling: The innate support grant will be restored but remains zero DPS on a zero-damage effect. Do not replace selection with a damaging child or invent bell-strike cadence.

modifiers.name: CooldownRecovery
modifiers.reason: CooldownRecovery is read as INC, MORE only, not as BASE

finding.status: unresolved repeat-cadence output gap; no formula change
finding.cause: base_cooldown_modifiable_repeat_interval_ms is retained but mapped to CooldownRecovery BASE, which is read only as INC/MORE. The game says recovery modifiers apply to repeat frequency; effect level row has no activation cooldown.
finding.oracle_basis: Reference writes the repeat interval into Cooldown; Time of Need also caps fallback action rate by it. Ghost Dance retains zero Speed.
finding.limit: Mapping this to SkillCooldownBase would label internal cadence as an activation cooldown. No new repeat view/state, recovery uptime, stack history or action model introduced; not declared known/effectless.
